dedupe_keys.name: time series dataset of electrical load profiles in an engineering faculty

description: Time-Series Dataset of Electrical Load Profiles in an Engineering Faculty is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors SUNAY TURKDOGAN, ISMAIL ASLAN (University of Yalova). This dataset provides high-resolution time-series measurements of the electrical energy consumption and power quality of an engineering faculty building at Yalova University, Türkiye. Data were collected at the building’s main entrance using a Fluke 435-II Energy Analyzer over the period 25 March – 1 April 2022. Coverage: national (TR); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
